person_note: The volume is a collection whose autonomous novellas use more than one controlling narrative person. The Goodreads evidence independently shows sustained retrospective first-person narration in the Craig material (q04526, q04534, q04538, q04540) and sustained third-person narration in q04541. A Tier C whole-book structural guide confirms that 'Mr. Harrigan's Phone' is first person while 'Rat' and material in 'The Life of Chuck' are third person. First-person language in q04520-q04521 is only tagged character thought, and other first- or second-person aphorisms and speech are local rather than additional base strands. Confidence is medium because the whole-book structural evidence is commercial rather than scholarly or authorized.
